event_description: Connecticut 20210902-Ida-declaration-of-civil-preparedness-emergency. From FMCSA's copy: As a result of the severe flooding throughout the State caused by heavy rain from the remnants of Hurricane Ida, which has caused widespread damage, interfered with transportation, and which continues to pose significant potential risk to public safety
Connecticut Declaration of Civil Preparedness Emergency 08192024. From FMCSA's copy: Yesterday, August 18, Connecticut experienced historic flooding due to severe rainstorms in portions of the state.
